@dataclass
class CreateBatch(Command):
    ref: str
    sku: str
    qty: int
    eta: Optional[date] = None
    expiry: Optional[date] = None

def __init__(self, ref: str, sku: str, qty: int, eta: Optional[date], expiry: Optional[date] = None):
    self.reference = ref
    self.sku = sku
    self.eta = eta
    self.expiry = expiry
    self._purchased_quantity = qty
    self._allocations = set()  # type: Set[OrderLine]
